home.title: CONIGLIOVERDE
home.text: Coniglioverde is inspired by Eduardo Kac’s Alba project. It is a multimedia exhibition space and a research laboratory on the hybridation between poetics and technologies.

writing.text: In the time of half-realities, virtual worlds, and AIs that can imitate thought, we seek our way to reconnect with words.

cinematic.text: Moving images have multiplied and fragmented on screens of all kinds, outside and inside ourselves.

static.text: In the flow of time images pass by, but some remain entangled, sticking to the gaze. Visiting this gallery you can find projects created with AI, generative software, and sensors. Old and new tools to explore the relationship between the visible and the imaginary.

data.text: We produce an ever-growing amount of data, until — over time — we ourselves become its product.
